description: Adapted-model defaults for the flagprof training tasks. When the user names a model listed here, --pooling / --rerank-score can be omitted and the recorded default is used and recorded in the protocol; an explicit CLI flag always wins. Entries are matched by model directory name, then by the longest matching prefix rule. provenance 'trained-verified' means this exact model+option pair completed training runs on PPU hardware; 'official-default' means the value follows the model publisher's documented default and the pair has not been separately trained.

bge-m3.note: XLMRoberta dense; CLS pooling per official dense-retrieval usage; last-token pooling also trained in validation

Qwen3-Reranker-8B.note: Two-card FSDP fine-tuning verified on PPU (performance mode, adamw, 2 steps); FP32 parameters + AdamW + gradients are about 128 GB and exceed a single 96 GB card, so DDP replication cannot host it and sharding is the verified path.

jina-embeddings-v3.note: publisher default uses task LoRA with mean pooling; only the plain AutoModel mean path is covered here

OneRec-1.7B.note: Qwen3ForCausalLM architecture (OpenOneRec/OneRec-1.7B); single-card causal-lm fine-tuning verified on PPU via registry task default and auto-generated deterministic token corpus; generative-recommendation objectives (multi-task/RL) stay outside the standard task scope
